_readme: Save pictures as images/pairs/NN-real.webp and images/pairs/NN-ai.webp (NN = pair number). Fill tools/pairs-credits.json for every real picture, then run: node tools/build-pairs-json.mjs

assumptions.meaning: ai.wh = 0.6 Wh x tries (estimate, not a measurement). Update `tries` with the real number. Water in the game = Wh x 1 ml (x4 with the power-generation toggle).

pairs.subject: a mountain lake at sunrise with pine trees
pairs.tell: Colors are too perfect: a glowing pastel sky, a mirror-flat reflection and every tree equally sharp.

ai.prompt: a mountain lake at sunrise with pine trees

real.look: an ordinary, slightly imperfect amateur-looking photo (not too polished)
real.sources: Pexels, Unsplash, Wikimedia Commons (filter: public domain / CC0), Openverse

pairs.subject: a bowl of ramen with a soft-boiled egg
